sentences: 在 2026-11-27 这一档，同一张 ¥1,000,000 的单有两个词：整手面读 **TRADABLE_AT_1000000**（5 名各至少 1 手、残差 0.0750% NAV），供给闸读 **ADMIT**（唯一没过的是 （闸没写哪条））——前者数的是 100 份一手，后者才是「这本书准不准持有」。
本条要回答的是「改尺寸能不能换来许可」：从 250,000 到 4,000,000，两年份额恒为 73.45%（线 70.00%），到线的距离恒为 -9.02pp——换成本金只是同一段距离值不同的钱（-31,854 → -509,657），所以**缩放这张单不会让判词翻面**。
要翻面，改的是**年形状**不是本金：2025 那一年少 9.02pp，换成当时 100 万本金上就是 -127,414 元，top-2 才回到线下——这与「等几年再说」是两件事，也与「买小一点」是两件事。
哪张回执说话：**etf_book_wrapper_year_gate**（cutoff 2026-11-27），因为它读的是这张单所在的那一档；etf_book_partial_year_caliber 也留着，但它回答的是另一个问题（换口径会不会换词）——在三种口径下这本书都读 ADMIT，所以它没有资格把词改回 ADMIT。

etf_capacity.sentence: 同一笔单子（1,000,000 元、5 个名字等权），最近 60 个交易日里有 60 天过线、0 天不过线。今天这一行是 0.2027%（最弱的是 159887），闸线 1.00%；把这把尺子倒过来读，在今天的成交额上能过的资本上限是 4,934,482 元，离 1,000,000 元差 -3,934,482 元。今天还是这段窗里最好的一天（读数最低），所以这个 DENY 不是当天的运气。按这段窗的中位算，上限是 4,323,294 元；按最差的一天算，只有 3,602,528 元——「装不下 100 万」这句要换成「平常装得下多少」。
caveats: 这笔单子固定成今天的选票、等权：量的是尺子的余量，不是「重新选票后那些天会填成什么样」
成交额用的是闸自己的口径（收盘价×成交量、中位再取中位），不是成交明细：它是估计值而且是阶梯状的，所以读数一格一格跳
「1% ADV」是闸选定的线，不是量出来的线；换一条线，这里每个数按同一比例移动
读数在窗内上下走是市场成交额在走，不是这本书在走；这里没有一句话说明天会读到什么
资本上限是一个资本数，不是一张能下的单：整数手与 8% 波动目标都可能把它压得更低（见 etf_book_ticket_floor / etf_book_lot_floor）

caveats: 成交额用的是闸自己的口径（收盘价×成交量，中位再取中位），是估计值而且是阶梯状的
「1% ADV」是闸选的线，不是量出来的线；换线，每个数按同一比例移动
这里量的是「这张单能不能从这个市场的成交额里过」，不是「下单后价格会被推到哪」：冲击成本是另一条腿（既有回测里按 8bp/边记）

carry_margin.sentence: 保证金不是门槛：保证金臂要追平波动臂首档，需要初始保证金率到 91.7%、98.2%（IC/IM 各自的临界值），而现实中券商收 12-15%。所以开仓资金线仍由 8% 波动尺决定；保证金只吃掉其中一部分现金，不改变 1 手首档。反过来说——若改用保证金口径，账户能开的杠杆是波动预算的若干倍，风险会失控，这正是不能拿保证金当尺子的原因。

cb_sleeve_today.rule_sentence: cash in the cb sleeve while the label reads rich; back into the sleeve as soon as the label leaves rich
unverified: the premium regime is a market-wide median; the sleeve holds 20 bonds, so a market-rich month need not be a sleeve-rich month
the rule is priced on monthly switches only; intra-month runs are not modelled
the cb arm and the etf arm are the parents' published arms -- this face does not re-test them

there is one window: 2020-02-29..2026-11-27. The CB market was rich in 46 of 81 labelled months and in cash in 46 of them, so the rule reads mostly as 'be out of the sleeve when it is expensive' over a single premium cycle -- a repeated reading is what would make its 0.142 pp a month edge durable
the cheap side holds only 3 falling months -- the cheap-vs-rich split is printed for the record and is not evidence of anything

the sleeve's own premium jumps at rebalances (a pick turns over half the 20 bonds), so part of its month-end reading is 'which bonds we happen to hold', not only 'how expensive they are' -- the coverage gate cannot see that
the sleeve ruler still has only one premium cycle in it (81 labelled months); a second cycle is what would tell us whether the two rulers converge in a genuinely cheap market

an expanding-window tertile cannot call a structurally falling series rich: the sleeve reads rich in 3 of 81 months and the market in 46, so the two arms do not fire equally often -- the recent-window arm is published beside them for that reason, not as a tiebreak
premium on a held bond can be stale on its last quoted day; the coverage gate drops a month below 80% coverage, it does not correct the rest

Per yuan it needs (1,159,599), the lot returns 9.62% against 8.00% risk (Sharpe 1.20) while the ETF book returns 10.89% against 10.51% (Sharpe 1.08). That rung is 1.16x this capital, so the swap is not buyable today.
caveats: Ruler A reads the sizing face's own hedged-vol figure; ruler C multiplies the risk face's ann_vol by the same notional. They differ by -18.9% on IC (different windows) and are printed side by side, never averaged.
The ETF book's vol is its measured 8%-target implementation (it de-levers only), not the 8% target itself.
Replacing the ETF core also removes its bond/cash defensive leg; this face prices risk and return, not the drawdown path in a crash.
One lot is a discrete jump: there is no partial lot below the first rung.
